entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Steve. How can I help you today?
Hi Steve. I need to make a return. I bought a cycling jersey a few weeks ago and it's just not what I was hoping for.
Okay, I can definitely help you with that. Can I get your order number, please?
Thank you. Let me pull that up... I see the order for the Aero-Pro Jersey, delivered 25 days ago. That's well within the **90 days** return window, so **no problem** at all.
Oh, that's great! I was a little worried I had waited too long.

Not at all. I can email you a prepaid **return label** right now. And since you're one of our VIP members, I've also added a 15% discount coupon to your account for your next purchase, just to thank you for your loyalty.
Wow, that's fantastic! I really appreciate that. You've made this incredibly easy.
It's my pleasure. The return label is on its way to your inbox. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's all. Thank you so much, Steve!
You're very welcome. Thanks for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
